title: Find polarity on the bond
statement:
Which atom is the partial-negative end of an O–F bond?

[_]{a}

explanations: Fluorine is more electronegative than oxygen.
An O–F bond has unequal sharing.
A bond dipole has opposite ends.

hints: Fluorine attracts shared electrons more strongly.
The greater electron density is the partial-negative end.
solution: Compare electronegativities. Fluorine attracts shared electrons more strongly. The greater electron density is the partial-negative end. Fluorine is more electronegative than oxygen.
